keyEvents.text: Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Manchester City 0, Fulham 1. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Oscar Bobb.
Calvin Bassey (Fulham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Shea Charles (Fulham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Manchester City 1, Fulham 1. Elliot Anderson (Manchester City) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal following a corner.
Substitution, Fulham. Hugo Larsson replaces Josh King.
Substitution, Fulham. Antonee Robinson replaces Alex Iwobi.
Substitution, Manchester City. Rayan Cherki replaces Phil Foden.
Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Fulham. Gonzalo García replaces Oscar Bobb.
Substitution, Manchester City. Allan replaces Iliman Ndiaye.
Substitution, Manchester City. Josko Gvardiol replaces Nico O'Reilly.
Substitution, Fulham. César Palacios replaces Ryan Sessegnon.
Substitution, Fulham. Tom Cairney replaces Rodrigo Muniz.
Substitution, Manchester City. Enzo Fernández replaces Ayyoub Bouaddi.
